group.label: Cats make the world go 'round. · Group

lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 102210105
Nero has invited {AccountData.NickName} to join the group.
Nero has invited Biscuit to join the group.
Nero has invited Leona to join the group.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Whoa, Trainer is in here too? U^ᴥ^U

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: What's this group chat for?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: To discuss and share any updates regarding Ruru's condition.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: It was my idea to form this group chat.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I figured it would make it easier for all of us to stay in the loop,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: and to help out in any way we can if possible.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Gotcha.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Well, speaking of, what's Ruru up to at the moment, Nero?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: She's grooming Scoops.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: No kidding!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: How does it feel to be groomed, Trainer?
It tickles.
Feels good.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Makes sense.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: It's the good kind of tickling, hehe.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Isn't it the best?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: It's so warm and tickly.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I wanna get groomed too U´ᴥ`U

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Next time, you and Leona can do it together.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'd love that!
Can I join?
Is that not okay?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Hehe, just joking.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I just wanted to see how you'd react.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I will do it again for you next time, Scoops.
Thanks.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I have to say,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Ruru is much smaller in real life than I thought she'd be.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I don't think she's been eating properly over the past few days.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: It was hard to watch.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I can only imagine the ordeal that poor thing went through on the streets.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I know...

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: It's a good thing Nero and the others found her.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: If they hadn't...

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Why do you think she doesn't want to come to the shelter?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I was wondering that myself.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: She doesn't have any problem with the dogs,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: and she gets along with me and Trainer

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: like a house on fire.
Are you sure you weren't the only one having fun?
It was a lot of fun playing with her.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Uh-oh...

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Do you think I was the only one having fun?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I thought for sure Ruru enjoyed herself too...
No, it was a lot of fun.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Hehehe

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I just wish Ruru would come to the shelter.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: She'll have a fun time here, I just know it.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: We have to give her some time.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: She'll warm up to the idea at some point.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Meow

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: That's what I think as well.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: It's just a matter of time.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: If anything crops up,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: post it to this group chat ASAP.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Will do.
